stemMd: If a sensor is active, its indicator is lit. The indicator is not lit. What follows?

options.label: C
options.textMd: Every unlit device is a sensor.

explanationMd: The contrapositive of active implies lit is not lit implies not active. A cause of inactivity cannot be inferred.

distractorRationale.d: This would require a lit indicator.
distractorRationale.e: The premises do not specify why it is inactive.
distractorRationale.b: The premises contain no future prediction.
